The anchor function is the first target-specific typed-array value constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after two-stage button routing, click-time collection, markdown draft state collection, staged routing, commit forwarding, internal queue delivery and typed-array input preparation, its own function body constructs the target observable typed_array_payload value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, wrapping a returned value, or emitting to the console. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return a generic DOM reader, markdown parser, queue observer, stage/commit router, byte utility reused outside the target path, a resolver wrapper that only forwards the call, or the final console sink.

Example value pattern: ^ta_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24}$
Observable: {'type': 'console', 'action': 'markdown.preview', 'field': 'typed_array_payload', 'value_pattern': '^ta_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24}$'}
